description: This file defines an interface for an adapter that handles error responses in the Eclipse Ditto protocol. It specifies default behaviors for retrieving criteria and actions related to error topics, and indicates that it is used for error response handling.

classes.name: ErrorResponseAdapter
classes.description: An interface for adapting error responses, extending the generic Adapter interface, and providing default method implementations related to error topics.

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Returns a set containing the criterion for error messages, used to filter topics related to errors.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns all possible actions applicable to error topics.

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates that this adapter is intended for use with responses, returning true.
